title: Ppp2r1a loss defines a cortical Amy1/Leng8/Stmn4/Rsrp1 signature with TSC/STXBP1-positive and LIMK1/DNAJB6-negative neighbors
exact_observed_result: In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Ppp2r1a perturbation produced a mixed recurrent marker panel: Amy1, Stmn4, Jun, Pcsk1n, Ovgp1, and Rnpc3 were induced, while Leng8, Rsrp1, Kifc2, and Pabpn1 were repressed. The report treated Stxbp1/Tsc1/Tsc2 positive and Limk1/Dnajb6 negative neighbors as exploratory restricted-signature comparators.
biological_interpretation: PP2A scaffold loss yields a practical cortical reporter state, but the recurrent markers are stronger than the proposed TSC/STXBP1/LIMK1 mechanistic assignment.
caveats: The story is best supported as a biomarker panel; the restricted TSC/STXBP1/LIMK1/DNAJB6 neighbor links are correlation-based and tentative.
The exact neighbor correlations were report-derived rather than direct rows in the DE Parquet.

prior_expectation.summary: PP2A holoenzymes contain scaffold, catalytic, and regulatory subunits; PPP2R1A and PPP2R5D variants can cause PP2A-related intellectual disability
